ai.title: SDK forwards end-user id through agent run, step, and model requests
ai.summary: The SDK now accepts an end-user id on agent runs, agent steps, and model provider requests and attaches it to outgoing requests as the `x-freebuff-acting-user-id` header so trusted service accounts can act on behalf of a signed-in user. The id flows from `RunOptions.userId` in `sdk/src/run.ts` into `callMainPrompt`, into `getModelForRequest` and `createCodebuffBackendModel` in `sdk/src/impl/model-provider.ts`, and into `startAgentRun`, `finishAgentRun`, and `addAgentStep` in `sdk/src/impl/database.ts`, where each conditionally sets `FREEBUFF_ACTING_USER_HEADER` only when the id is supplied. A matching `GetUserInfoByIdInput` and `GetUserInfoByIdFn` pair was added to `common/src/types/contracts/database.ts`, giving the shared database contract a type-level path for user lookup by id. The new header is omitted entirely when no user id is present, matching ordinary API key behavior that cannot delegate.
ai.evidence: The diff adds `userId` to `startAgentRun`/`finishAgentRun`/`addAgentStep` params in `sdk/src/impl/database.ts` and threads it into request headers via `FREEBUFF_ACTING_USER_HEADER`; in `sdk/src/impl/model-provider.ts`, `getModelForRequest` and `createCodebuffBackendModel` gain a `userId` parameter that is forwarded on model requests; in `sdk/src/run.ts`, `RunOptions.userId` is plumbed through `runOnce` to `callMainPrompt`. New types `GetUserInfoByIdInput`/`GetUserInfoByIdFn` were added to `common/src/types/contracts/database.ts`, confirmed by `delegated-user-header.test.ts` assertions for "sends userId on model requests", "sends userId on agent run and step requests", and "omits the internal header when userId is not supplied".
ai.unknowns: The server-side consumer of `x-freebuff-acting-user-id` and whether `GetUserInfoByIdFn` resolves to a real database query are not shown in the diff.

changes.what: End-user id is accepted on agent runs and forwarded through model and agent-run requests as a trusted header
A user-by-id lookup input and function type were added to the database contract

ai.title: Spend-limited sessions route to landing screen with return timer
ai.summary: The CLI now treats the cross-model Freebuff provider-spend budget as a surfaced state instead of an opaque error. The server returns status='spend_limited' (message, resetAt, retryAfterMs) on a rejected fresh admission, and callSession in use-freebuff-session.ts accepts both 'rate_limited' and 'spend_limited' from 429 POST bodies so the landing screen can explain the limit and show when the user can try again. app.tsx adds 'spend_limited' to the gate that routes non-admitted sessions to FreebuffLandingScreen, while freebuff-landing-screen.tsx renders a new 'Daily Freebuff limit reached' block reusing the existing formatRetryAfter helper; nextDelayMs returns null for spend_limited so polling stops. Existing sessions are never interrupted because this status only blocks fresh session admission.
ai.evidence: common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts adds a new 'spend_limited' variant to the FreebuffSessionServerResponse union type with status, accessTier, message, resetAt, retryAfterMs; cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts returns spend_limited bodies from 429 POSTs in callSession and lists it among the terminal (null-returning) cases in nextDelayMs; cli/src/app.tsx adds session.status === 'spend_limited' to the gate routing the user to <FreebuffLandingScreen>; cli/src/components/freebuff-landing-screen.tsx renders a new spend_limited block with heading 'Daily Freebuff limit reached' and formatRetryAfter(session.retryAfterMs).
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show the server-side code that emits the 429 with status='spend_limited' or how the provider-spend budget is tracked, only the CLI/client types that consume it.

changes.what: Added 'spend_limited' variant to FreebuffSessionServerResponse with status, accessTier, message, resetAt, and retryAfterMs fields.
callSession now returns bodies with status='spend_limited' from 429 POST responses, and nextDelayMs returns null for spend_limited to stop polling.
Added session.status === 'spend_limited' to the gate routing non-admitted sessions to the FreebuffLandingScreen.
Added a new spend_limited rendering block with heading 'Daily Freebuff limit reached' and a return-time computed via formatRetryAfter.

eli5.text: When you ask the assistant to edit part of a very large file, it used to read only a shortened preview of that file before making the change. Now it reads the entire file when doing those edits, so it can find and modify the exact spot you pointed to even if it sits deep in a long document. The default behavior of only reading a short preview is unchanged for normal reading tasks.

facts: Only advertise GLM when the recurring full-access streak entitlement is active, so the copy never promises a perk the gate won't honor.

ai.title: Streak GLM bonus becomes recurring weekly perk gated on live
ai.summary: The full-access GLM 5.2 streak reward moved from a one-time grant on exact 7/14/21 milestone days to a recurring weekly +1 session derived live from the current streak, refilling each Monday Pacific while the streak stays at 7+ days and shutting off the moment the streak breaks. `getFreebuffStreakGlmBonusUnits` replaces the removed `streakRewardPools` milestone check on `isFreebuffStreakMilestone`, returning `FREEBUFF_STREAK_BONUS_SESSION_UNITS` only when `streak >= FREEBUFF_STREAK_REWARD_INTERVAL_DAYS` and `isFreebuffStreakGlmBonusActive()` is true. The CLI now advertises this weekly GLM perk via `getFreebuffStreakBonusNote` only for full-access users, so the copy never promises the perk when the `FREEBUFF_GLM_V52_REFERRAL_ENABLED` / `FREEBUFF_STREAK_GLM_BONUS_ENABLED` / `FREEBUFF_STREAK_REWARDS_ENABLED` trio is not all active. Three files changed: `cli/src/utils/freebuff-streak-line.ts`, `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, and `common/src/util/freebuff-streak.ts`.
ai.evidence: The diff to `common/src/util/freebuff-streak.ts` removes `isFreebuffStreakMilestone` and `streakRewardPools`, adds `getFreebuffStreakGlmBonusUnits` and `getFreebuffDailyStreakRewardPool`, and replaces the milestone-day GLM grant with a live weekly bonus derived from the 7+ day streak. `cli/src/utils/freebuff-streak-line.ts` updates `getFreebuffStreakBonusNote` to advertise the recurring weekly GLM perk only when `isFreebuffStreakGlmBonusActive()` confirms the gate, and `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` updates the streak-reward comment block to describe the weekly refill/reset behavior.
ai.unknowns: The exact consumer that calls `getFreebuffStreakGlmBonusUnits` and persists the weekly +1 into the GLM quota ledger is not shown in the diff. A second read of the same diff did not confirm that a migration step is required.

changes.what: Replaced the milestone-day GLM grant with a live weekly GLM bonus resolved from the current streak, and renamed the daily pool helper to return a single non-GLM pool instead of an array.
Updated the streak perk note to advertise the recurring weekly GLM session only when the full-access GLM entitlement is active.
Rewrote the streak-reward comment block to describe the GLM bonus refilling weekly on Monday while the streak holds and shutting off when it breaks.

entries.title: CLI update: use-gravity-ad
entries.summary: New files: `common/src/util/ad-user-agent.ts`.

ai.title: Extract shared ad user agent into common package
ai.summary: A new shared `getAdUserAgent` in `common/src/util/ad-user-agent.ts` exports a stable Chrome-on-{os} user agent per platform, imported by the CLI ads hook. `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts` now sends this shared browser-like `userAgent` in the `/api/v1/ads` request body, replacing the hook's previous local copy so every native client reports a consistent targeting signal instead of a runtime UA such as `Bun/<version>`. The helper normalizes `macos`/`windows` aliases and falls back to the `linux` UA for unknown platforms. This is an internal refactor of the advertising subsystem.
ai.evidence: New file `common/src/util/ad-user-agent.ts` exports `getAdUserAgent`. `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts` imports it and sends the shared value as the `userAgent` field in the `/api/v1/ads` POST body, replacing the local definition.
ai.unknowns: The rollout of the shared UA to other native clients (e.g. web or desktop) is not shown in this diff, as it only touches the CLI hook and adds the shared helper.

changes.what: Replaced the local `getAdUserAgent()` definition with an import from the shared package and sends its value as the `userAgent` field in the /api/v1/ads body.
Added a shared platform-keyed Chrome user agent helper that accepts `macos`/`windows` aliases and falls back to the `linux` UA for unknown platforms.
